- **`BuildOwner`** — `@Validated`; `service(@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto, OwnerMapper, Out<Owner> built, Out<Boolean> sharesHousehold) throws MissingOwnerFieldsException, InvalidTelephoneException, InvalidEmailException`. Publishes `sharesHousehold`; normalizes address (`Addresses.normalize`); checks required fields (firstName,lastName,address,city,telephone) throwing `MissingOwnerFieldsException(missing)`; normalizes telephone to E.164 (`Telephones.toE164`); normalizes email; maps to `Owner`; sets registrationDate default = today, rolled forward off weekends (Sat+2/Sun+1) to a business day. **Note: no public-holiday roll here** (the test's `toBusinessDay` also skips holidays — a gap).

- **`SaveOwner`** — `service(@Val Owner, OwnerRepository)` → `save`.
- **`LoadOwner`** — `service(@PathVariable("ownerId") Integer, OwnerRepository, Out<Owner>) throws NotFoundException` via `common.Lookups.findOrNotFound`.
- **`DeleteOwner`** — `service(@Val Owner, OwnerRepository)` → `delete` (note: actual hard delete despite test comment mentioning soft-delete).
- **`ListOwners`** — GET list, optional `lastName` RequestParam; 404 when empty else 200 list of `OwnerDto`.
- **`ListOwnersPage`** — v2 paged list; `lastName`/`page`/`size` params, default size 20 sorted by id; returns `OwnerPageDto`.
- **`AssignHousehold`** — when `sharesHousehold`, derives/reuses a stable `householdId` (SHA-256 of normalized lastName+address, `HH-` + 6 hex bytes) shared across same last name+address; back-fills members.
- **`EnsureUniqueIdentity`** — throws `DuplicateIdentityException` when whole `identityKey` already used.
- **`AssignCustomerCode`** — sets `customerCode` = `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`, NNNN = per-city sequence (count in city + 1).
- **`AssignNamesakeCount`** — sets `namesakeCount` = existing owners with same first+last (case-insensitive).
- **`EnsureCityCapacity`** — throws `CityAtCapacityException` when city already has ≥50 owners (`MAX_OWNERS_PER_CITY = 50`, normalized case-insensitive city compare).
- **`EnsureDailyOwnerLimit`** — throws `DailyOwnerLimitException` when ≥100 owners share the registrationDate (`MAX_OWNERS_PER_DAY = 100`).
- **`AuditOwnerCreated`** — logs to `AUDIT` slf4j logger (id, customerCode, registrationDate, membershipLevel).
- **`RespondWithOwnerCreated`** — 201 Created, `Location: /api/owners/{id}`, body `OwnerDto`.

- **`RespondWithOwnerUpdated`** — `ResponseEntity.status(NO_CONTENT).body(ownerDto)`.
- **`OwnerIdentity`** (util) — `key(owner)` = `telephone|email|householdId`.
- **`OwnerEmails`** (package-private util) — `normalize(email)`: blank passes through; regex `^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$`; returns lower-cased; else `InvalidEmailException`.
- **`Addresses`** (package-private util) — `normalize`: trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand ST→STREET/RD→ROAD/AVE→AVENUE.
- **`Telephones`** (package-private util) — `toE164`: strips separators, keeps `+`/country code or assumes `+61` (drops one leading `0`); validates `\+\d{8,15}`; per-country national length (`+61`→9, `+1`→10); else `InvalidTelephoneException`.

- **City in customerCode**: `AssignCustomerCode` uses first 3 letters of city.
- `city` is a first-class `@NotEmpty` field on `Owner` and required in `OwnerFields` schema.
- **`postcode` / `postCode`: NOT present anywhere in `src/main`** (java, yaml, or `openapi.yml`) — confirmed by grep. It exists ONLY in tests.
- **`NSW`/`VIC`/`QLD`**: appear in `OwnerMapper.CITY_REGION`, `openapi.yml` example/description text, and in the test base's reference tables. `SwaggerConfig.java` also matched the grep (generic license text, not owner logic).

---

## 6. Existing owner tests

Directory `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/`:
- **`AcceptanceTest.java`** — 3 `@Test`s, all about **postcode** (a not-yet-implemented feature): `coreStoresValidPostcode` (POST with `postcode:"2000"`, expects it echoed on GET at `$.postcode`), `coreAcceptsOwnerWithoutPostcode` (postcode optional), `errorRejectsMalformedPostcode` (`postcode:"12"` → 400). These will currently fail/ignore the field.
- **`AcceptanceBase.java`** — the harness (322 lines) all tests extend.
- **`AuditLogCapture.java`** — 79-line helper to capture the `AUDIT` logger output.

**Framework / style**: JUnit 5 (`org.junit.jupiter`), **Spring Boot `@SpringBootTest` + `@AutoConfigureMockMvc`**, driven through **`MockMvc`** (not a live HTTP client), `@Transactional` rollback per test, `@WithMockUser(roles={OWNER_ADMIN,VET_ADMIN,ADMIN})` for auth. ---

## 7. Build file & running tests

- Build file: **`/home/daniel/sandbox/pom.xml`** (Maven). `spring-petclinic-rest` 4.0.2, parent `spring-boot-starter-parent` 4.1.0, OfficeFloor 4.0.2 (`officefloor-rest-spring-boot-4-starter`), custom repo `officefloor-stage-repository`. ## 8. Validation classes / annotations for owners

Two layers:

1. **Bean Validation (JSR-380)** — triggered by `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto` in `ValidateOwner` and `BuildOwner` (both class-annotated `@Validated`). Constraints live on the generated `OwnerFieldsDto` (from `openapi.yml`: `minLength`/`maxLength`/`pattern` on firstName/lastName/address/city/telephone, `format: email`) and on the `Owner` entity itself (`@NotEmpty` on address/city/telephone, `@Pattern` E.164 on telephone). ## 4. Owner function classes

All in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`. Key contents (full source was read; summarizing the load-bearing signatures/logic):

- **`ValidateOwner`** — `@Validated`; `service(@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto request, Out<OwnerFieldsDto> validated) throws InvalidEmailException`. Normalizes email (lower-case, syntactic check) and republishes. Runs before Load on PUT so a bad body is 400 even for a missing owner.
- **`BuildOwner`** — `@Validated`; `service(@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto, OwnerMapper, Out<Owner> built, Out<Boolean> sharesHousehold) throws MissingOwnerFieldsException, InvalidTelephoneException, InvalidEmailException`. Publishes `sharesHousehold`; normalizes address (`Addresses.normalize`); checks required fields (firstName,lastName,address,city,telephone) throwing `MissingOwnerFieldsException(missing)`; normalizes telephone to E.164 (`Telephones.toE164`); normalizes email; maps to `Owner`; sets registrationDate default = today, rolled forward off weekends (Sat+2/Sun+1) to a business day. **Note: no public-holiday roll here** (the test's `toBusinessDay` also skips holidays — a gap).
- **`ApplyOwner`** — `service(@Val Owner owner, @Val OwnerFieldsDto request)` copies address/city/firstName/lastName/telephone/email onto the loaded owner (PUT path). **Does not copy postcode (none exists).**
- **`SaveOwner`** — `service(@Val Owner, OwnerRepository)` → `save`.
- **`LoadOwner`** — `service(@PathVariable("ownerId") Integer, OwnerRepository, Out<Owner>) throws NotFoundException` via `common.Lookups.findOrNotFound`.
- **`DeleteOwner`** — `service(@Val Owner, OwnerRepository)` → `delete` (note: actual hard delete despite test comment mentioning soft-delete).
- **`ListOwners`** — GET list, optional `lastName` RequestParam; 404 when empty else 200 list of `OwnerDto`.
- **`ListOwnersPage`** — v2 paged list; `lastName`/`page`/`size` params, default size 20 sorted by id; returns `OwnerPageDto`.
- **`AssignHousehold`** — when `sharesHousehold`, derives/reuses a stable `householdId` (SHA-256 of normalized lastName+address, `HH-` + 6 hex bytes) shared across same last name+address; back-fills members.
- **`EnsureUniqueIdentity`** — throws `DuplicateIdentityException` when whole `identityKey` already used.
- **`AssignCustomerCode`** — sets `customerCode` = `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`, NNNN = per-city sequence (count in city + 1).
- **`AssignNamesakeCount`** — sets `namesakeCount` = existing owners with same first+last (case-insensitive).
- **`EnsureCityCapacity`** — throws `CityAtCapacityException` when city already has ≥50 owners (`MAX_OWNERS_PER_CITY = 50`, normalized case-insensitive city compare).
- **`EnsureDailyOwnerLimit`** — throws `DailyOwnerLimitException` when ≥100 owners share the registrationDate (`MAX_OWNERS_PER_DAY = 100`).
- **`AuditOwnerCreated`** — logs to `AUDIT` slf4j logger (id, customerCode, registrationDate, membershipLevel).
- **`RespondWithOwnerCreated`** — 201 Created, `Location: /api/owners/{id}`, body `OwnerDto`.
- **`RespondWithOwner`** — 200 body `OwnerDto`.
- **`RespondWithOwnerUpdated`** — `ResponseEntity.status(NO_CONTENT).body(ownerDto)`.
- **`OwnerIdentity`** (util) — `key(owner)` = `telephone|email|householdId`.
- **`OwnerEmails`** (package-private util) — `normalize(email)`: blank passes through; regex `^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$`; returns lower-cased; else `InvalidEmailException`.
- **`Addresses`** (package-private util) — `normalize`: trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand ST→STREET/RD→ROAD/AVE→AVENUE.
- **`Telephones`** (package-private util) — `toE164`: strips separators, keeps `+`/country code or assumes `+61` (drops one leading `0`); validates `\+\d{8,15}`; per-country national length (`+61`→9, `+1`→10); else `InvalidTelephoneException`.

Related owner-scoped functions elsewhere: `rest/function/owner/LoadOwnersPet.java`, `BuildOwnersPet.java`, `OwnerEmails`… and `rest/function/visit/BuildOwnersVisit.java`. `common.RespondWithNoContent` and `common.Lookups` are shared helpers.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164
            form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must have 8 to
            15 digits after the '+'. So '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            not supplied on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though
            another owner already has the same last name and address (a shared
            household). When false or omitted, such a duplicate is rejected with 409.
            Not stored on the owner.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where CITY3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased
                first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household (same last
                name at the same address). Assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' true, and shared by all members of that household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1B0C9D8E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key all duplicate detection is expressed through:
                the normalized telephone, the email (or empty when absent) and the
                householdId (or empty when absent), joined with '|'. A create is rejected
                with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing
                owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3F2A1B0C9D8E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (as of this owner's creation) that share
                the same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY
                is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level (1-3), assigned at creation: starts at 1,
                plus 1 when an email address is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0,
                capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region, derived from the city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 other owners have already been created for this
                owner's registrationDate (the same per-day accumulation the daily create
                limit enforces), signalling an unusually high volume of signups that day;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
